labs.summary_ko: Docker만으로 PostgreSQL과 ClickHouse를 띄워 pg_clickhouse 확장을 설치하고, 외부 스키마 가져오기, JOIN·집계 푸시다운, clickhouse_query와 딕셔너리 사용을 차례로 실습합니다.
labs.summary_en: With only Docker, run PostgreSQL and ClickHouse side by side, install the pg_clickhouse extension, import foreign schemas, watch JOIN and aggregate pushdown, and send ClickHouse SQL with clickhouse_query.

labs.summary_ko: 지리 연산은 Postgres에 두고 집계는 pg_clickhouse로 ClickHouse에 보내, 2,400만 행 대여 기록에서 어느 쪽이 답했는지 비교합니다.
labs.summary_en: Keep geography in Postgres and push the counting to ClickHouse through pg_clickhouse, then compare which side answered over 24M trips.

labs.summary_ko: Managed Postgres의 pgvector와 ClickHouse Cloud의 vector_similarity 인덱스로 같은 벡터를 색인해, 벡터 검색이 어느 규모부터 Postgres를 벗어나야 하는지 측정합니다.
labs.title_en: Vector search: pgvector, VectorChord and ClickHouse
labs.summary_en: Index the same vectors with pgvector on Managed Postgres and the vector_similarity index in ClickHouse Cloud, and measure where vector search stops belonging in Postgres; VectorChord cannot be created on the service.
